svg.aria-label: Two clients writing to two replicas
svg.desc: Time runs downward. Each client writes a different value to x and sends its update to replicas A and B. A receives client 2’s value v2 before client 1’s v1. B receives v1 before v2. Under last writer wins, both keep v2 when t2 is greater than t1 in the total timestamp order. A multi-value register keeps both values because neither write causally follows the other. The application resolves the conflict.
